LESSON: CONTROLLING SOIL EROSION

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: AGRICULTURE
Strand: CONSERVATION OF RESOURCES Strand Sub strand Specific learning outcomes Suggested
Topic 1.1: Controlling Soil Erosion

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Controlling Soil Erosion
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: How does erosion control conserve the environment?

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Controlling Soil Erosion

Teach

• Use safe examples only.
• Name → explain → apply.

Worked example
• Fact 1 about Controlling Soil Erosion (in pupil words).
• Fact 2 with a Kenyan example.
• Safe action connected to Controlling Soil Erosion.

Try this
• Draw/label one diagram for Controlling Soil Erosion.
• Write 5 bullet facts about Controlling Soil Erosion.
• Say one safety rule.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• describe types of soil erosion in the environment

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. List 8 facts on Controlling Soil Erosion.
2. Teach a friend using only bullet points.
